posts.author: Arwo
posts.body:
Hey
I would like to integrate steam achievements into my game.
I've looked for some tutorials online on how to do it and found some topics in written form from these forums.
However I always prefer to watch a video where every step is explained - I learn faster that way.
Does anyone know any youtube tutorial which I can watch on the above topic?
If not, which written guide would you recommend to read to easily understand how to integrate steam achievements into the game?
Thanks for help!

posts.author: LaCipolla
posts.body:
The most useful resource I've found is the
NekoGakuen Plugin
. It's free, and in the download, they have an EXCELLENT step-by-step guide. Most of the other guides I found were either for RPG Maker MV or severely outdated.
That being said, I have not yet succeeded in getting Achievements to work myself ... =_= Troubleshooting is kind of hard if you don't understand all the stuff happening in the background.
